requirements: Review only the scope candidate and its read-only validator; do not certify the 501-file product or release.
Separate candidate consistency from human acceptance, P0 baseline succession and production permission.
Verify literal path/blob/hash binding and committed, staged, unstaged and untracked product and gate coverage, including renames across scope boundaries.
Retain the original P0 checks, required security/database tests and historical failures; identify the remaining exact acceptance and succession requirements.
required_evidence: Exact Git snapshot and declared reference/test inputs, not mutable local untracked files.
The 13 regression assertions and their recorded ROOT result, including actual synthetic Git staged/committed rename coverage.
Report missing dependency or independent Git-delta evidence explicitly; do not assume a manifest is complete merely because it is self-consistent.
